title: Ivanti Avalanche WLAvalancheService TV_FP Null Pointer Dereference Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Ivanti Avalanche. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the WLAvalancheService service, which listens on TCP port 1777 by default. The issue results from dereferencing a null pointer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system.
